sentences.text: Nuuk -LRB- -LSB- nuːk -RSB- ; Godthåb -RRB- is the capital and largest city of Greenland and the municipality of Sermersooq .	Sermersooq	Sermersooq	capital	List of national capitals by latitude	largest city	List of cities and towns in Greenland	Greenland	Greenland	municipality	municipalities of Greenland
It is the seat of government and the country 's largest cultural and economic centre .	government	Government of Greenland

The major cities closest to the capital are Iqaluit and St. John 's in Canada and Reykjavík in Iceland .	capital	List of national capitals by latitude	Iqaluit	Iqaluit	Canada	Canada	Reykjavík	Reykjavík	Iceland	Iceland
Nuuk contains almost a third of Greenland 's population , and also has the tallest building in Greenland .	Greenland	Greenland
Nuuk is the seat of government for the Sermersooq municipality .	Sermersooq	Sermersooq	government	Government of Greenland	municipality	municipalities of Greenland

In January 2016 , it had a population of 17,316 , making it one of the smallest capital cities in the world by population .	capital	List of national capitals by latitude	capital cities in the world by population	List of national capitals by population
Nuuk is the Kalaallisut word for `` cape '' .	Kalaallisut	Kalaallisut language	cape	headland
It is so named because of its position at the end of the Nuup Kangerlua fjord on the eastern shore of the Labrador Sea .	Nuup Kangerlua	Nuup Kangerlua	fjord	fjord	Labrador Sea	Labrador Sea

Its latitude , at 64 ° 10 ' N , makes it the world 's northernmost capital , located only a few kilometres farther north than the Icelandic capital Reykjavík .	capital	List of national capitals by latitude	Reykjavík	Reykjavík	latitude	latitude	northernmost	List of northernmost items

Since 2009 , the city bus service Nuup Bussii provides city transport services in Nuuk for the new Sermersooq municipality , linking the town centre with the outlying districts and neighborhoods of Nuussuaq , Qinngorput , as well as Qernertunnguit in Quassussuup Tungaa . In 2012 the buses transported more than 2 million passengers around the city of Nuuk .

The campus of the University of Greenland , hosting Statistics Greenland , and the main holdings of the Public and National Library of Greenland is located at the northern end of the district , near the road to the Nuuk Airport .
